description: This file defines a class 'InternetConnectivity' with a static method 'isInternetConnected' that checks internet connectivity status via mobile data or Wi-Fi using Android's ConnectivityManager.

classes.name: InternetConnectivity
classes.description: A utility class providing method to check internet connectivity status.

methods.name: isInternetConnected
methods.description: A static method that returns true if either mobile data or Wi-Fi network is connected, false otherwise.
